comments.body: I believe the issue here is that the proxyFor triple is stored, but the hasMember triple is generated (based on the IndirectContainer's LDP membership triples). So it should be possible to update ReferencesRdfContext (which generates the inbound references triples) to look for proxies and add the same triples as inbound links.
Former user, I just ran through Trey Pendragon's script (see attached: notes.txt) and did not come up with the desired results. Could you double check?

I've updated https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/842 with some changes to the tests and session handling. I tried to address the core issue with ReferencesRdfContext.java, but wasn't able to get it working. I'll pick that back up on Monday.

Andrew Woods, the issue with Trey's script is that body-proxy.ttl doesn't have the ore:proxyIn triple (cf. https://github.com/escowles/ldp-pcdm/blob/master/ldp-cover-proxy.ttl), so there's no link up to the container that drives the generated predicates. The IT has the ore:proxyIn triple.

I've updated the PR to use a function-based approach:
